title: Thoracic Spine Manipulation for Neck Pain — Choosing Thrust or Non-Thrust

hook.en: Treating the upper back can ease neck pain. Learn who may benefit, how to choose between thrust and non-thrust techniques, and when to leave the thrust out.
hook.ur: Upper back ka ilaaj gardan ka dard kam kar sakta hai. Kis ko faida ho sakta hai, thrust aur non-thrust mein kaise chunein, aur kab thrust chhor dein, seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain why the thoracic spine is treated for neck pain, choose thrust or non-thrust from irritability and safety, and combine it with exercise and advice.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjha sakenge ke gardan ke dard mein thoracic spine ka ilaaj kyun hota hai, irritability aur safety se thrust ya non-thrust chunenge, aur use exercise aur advice ke saath jorenge.

text.en: The neck and the upper back work as one unit. A stiff **upper thoracic spine** makes the neck do extra work, and trials have shown that treating the thoracic spine with **thrust** or **non-thrust** mobilisation can reduce neck pain and disability, especially in the **short term**. The best results come when it is combined with **exercise** and **education**, not used alone.
text.ur: Gardan aur upper back ek unit ki tarah kaam karte hain. Akarha **upper thoracic spine** gardan se zyada kaam leta hai, aur trials ne dikhaya hai ke thoracic spine ko **thrust** ya **non-thrust** mobilisation se treat karne se gardan ka dard aur disability kam ho sakti hai, khaas kar **short term** mein. Behtareen nateeje tab milte hain jab isay **exercise** aur **education** ke saath jora jaye, akele nahi.

text.en: Imagine a long ladder leaning on a wall. If the bottom rungs are stiff, the top bends more to reach the same height. Loosening the lower (thoracic) part lets the upper (neck) part do less and settle.
text.ur: Ek lambi seedhi deewar se lagi sochein. Agar neeche ki seedhiyan akarhi hon to oopar ka hissa utni hi unchai tak pahunchne ke liye zyada mud-ta hai. Neeche ke (thoracic) hissay ko dheela karne se oopar ka (gardan) hissa kam kaam karta hai aur shaant hota hai.

steps.title: Screen first
steps.detail: Take the history, screen for red flags, check for vascular, neurological and bone-health problems, and explain the options and risks. || Pehle screen karein

steps.title: Decide thrust or non-thrust
steps.detail: Non-thrust mobilisation suits an irritable, very painful or anxious patient, or when a thrust is not safe. A thrust suits a less irritable patient who is comfortable with it and has no contraindication. || Thrust ya non-thrust ka faisla

steps.title: Deliver it carefully
steps.detail: Use a position you can control, keep the force small and the contact precise, and keep talking to the patient. A thrust is a small, fast movement at the end of the available range, never a force through pain. || Ehtiyat se dein

steps.title: Add exercise and re-test
steps.detail: Re-test neck movement and pain straight away, then teach a neck and upper-back exercise that keeps the gain. || Exercise jorein aur dobara test karein

question.en: A patient with severe, irritable neck pain, high anxiety and a very stiff upper back needs treatment today. What is the better choice?
question.ur: Shadeed, irritable gardan ke dard, bohat pareshani aur bohat akarhi upper back wale patient ko aaj ilaaj chahiye. Behtar choice kya hai?

text.en: A forceful thrust to the whole spine
text.ur: Poori reerh par zor ki thrust

feedback.en: A forceful thrust is not suited to an irritable, anxious patient.
feedback.ur: Zor ki thrust irritable, pareshan patient ke liye munasib nahi.

text.en: Non-thrust thoracic mobilisation, with advice and gentle movement
text.ur: Non-thrust thoracic mobilisation, advice aur halki harkat ke saath

feedback.en: Yes — it is gentler, can still reduce pain and fits an irritable, anxious patient.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh halka hai, phir bhi dard kam kar sakta hai aur irritable, pareshan patient ke liye munasib hai.

feedback.en: Gentle treatment and advice are appropriate.
feedback.ur: Halka ilaaj aur advice munasib hain.

rows.en: A small, fast movement at the end of range
rows.ur: Range ke end par chhoti, tez harkat

rows.en: Less irritable, stiff, comfortable with a thrust
rows.ur: Kam irritable, akarha, thrust se mutmain

rows.en: Irritable, painful, anxious, or when a thrust is not safe
rows.ur: Irritable, dardnak, pareshan, ya jab thrust mehfooz na ho

rows.en: Larger short-term effect in some trials
rows.ur: Kuch trials mein bara short-term asar

rows.en: Smaller but real effect and fewer risks
rows.ur: Chhota lekin asli asar aur kam risks

text.en: **Screen, choose, deliver, move.** Screen safely, choose by irritability and consent, deliver with control, then move and exercise.
text.ur: **Screen, chunen, den, harkat.** Mehfooz screen karein, irritability aur consent se chunen, qabu se den, phir harkat aur exercise.

text.en: **Treating the thrust as the whole treatment.** The effect is short; without exercise and advice the pain often returns. A patient who has only "got a crack" has not been given a way to keep the change.
text.ur: **Thrust ko poora ilaaj samajhna.** Asar chhota hota hai; exercise aur advice ke baghair dard aksar wapas aa jata hai. Jis patient ne sirf "crack" karwaya use badlao barqarar rakhne ka tareeqa nahi mila.

question.en: Which patient should not have a thoracic thrust?
question.ur: Kis patient ko thoracic thrust nahi dena chahiye?

text.en: A patient who has agreed after you explained the options
text.ur: Woh patient jo options samjhane ke baad raazi ho gaya

feedback.en: Informed consent is needed, and here it is given.
feedback.ur: Informed consent zaroori hai, aur yahan diya gaya hai.

text.en: A patient with osteoporosis and a recent fall, or with a history of cancer and night pain
text.ur: Osteoporosis aur haal ke girne wala, ya cancer ki history aur raat ke dard wala patient

feedback.en: Yes — a fracture risk or a possible serious condition is a reason not to thrust and to refer.
feedback.ur: Haan — fracture ka khatra ya mumkin serious bimari thrust na karne aur refer karne ki wajah hai.

text.en: A healthy 30-year-old with a stiff upper back and no red flags
text.ur: Sehatmand 30 saal ka insaan jis ki upper back akarhi hai aur red flags nahi

feedback.ur: Yeh patient munasib ho sakta hai.

question.en: What should you do straight after the technique?
question.ur: Technique ke foran baad kya karna chahiye?

text.en: Re-test the movement and pain, then teach an exercise
text.ur: Harkat aur dard dobara test karein, phir exercise sikhayen

feedback.en: Yes — re-testing shows the effect and the exercise helps to keep it.
feedback.ur: Haan — dobara test asar dikhata hai aur exercise ise barqarar rakhti hai.

text.en: Send the patient home without advice
text.ur: Patient ko advice ke baghair ghar bhej dein

feedback.en: The gain may not last without exercise and advice.
feedback.ur: Exercise aur advice ke baghair faida qayam nahi rehta.

feedback.en: Repeating a thrust adds risk without clear benefit.
feedback.ur: Thrust dohrane se risk barhta hai aur faida wazeh nahi.

text.en: **Document what you did.** Record the screening, the options you discussed, the consent, the technique and the response, and review at the next visit. If a prediction rule suggests a patient will benefit, use it as a guide only: the early rules have not held up well when tested again.
text.ur: **Jo kiya woh likhein.** Screening, jo options bataye, consent, technique aur response record karein, aur agli visit mein review karein. Agar koi prediction rule kehta hai ke patient ko faida hoga to use sirf rahnumai samjhein: shuruati rules dobara test hone par kamzor sabit hue.

question.en: Why might treating the upper back help a neck that hurts?
question.ur: Upper back ka ilaaj dardnak gardan ki madad kyun kar sakta hai?

answer.en: A stiff upper back forces the neck to do more movement, and both areas share muscles and nerve connections. Treatment to the thoracic spine can reduce pain, ease muscle guarding and improve neck movement, partly through the nervous system and partly through context effects.
answer.ur: Akarhi upper back gardan se zyada harkat karwati hai, aur dono hissay muscles aur nerve connections share karte hain. Thoracic spine ka ilaaj dard kam kar sakta hai, muscle guarding kam kar sakta hai aur gardan ki harkat behtar kar sakta hai, kuch nervous system ke zariye aur kuch context effects ke zariye.

beats.patient: A 36-year-old office worker has had neck pain for ten days with a stiff upper back and no arm symptoms. She is comfortable with manipulation after you explain it.
beats.assessment: There are no red flags, no neurological signs and no risk factors for fracture or vascular problems.
beats.treatment: Perform a thoracic thrust technique with careful control, re-test the movement and teach neck and upper back exercises.
beats.reassess: Movement and pain improve straight away, and a week later she is doing the exercises and has less pain.

text.en: **Do not thrust** over a suspected fracture or severe osteoporosis, spinal infection or tumour, inflammatory arthritis in an acute phase, spinal cord signs, or an unexplained neurological deficit, or if the patient does not consent. Take extra care with anticoagulants and a recent injury. If in doubt, use non-thrust mobilisation or refer.
text.ur: **Thrust na karein** shak wale fracture ya shadeed osteoporosis, reerh ke infection ya tumour, acute inflammatory arthritis, spinal cord signs, ya be-wajah neurological kami par, ya agar patient consent na de. Anticoagulants aur haal ki chot mein khaas ehtiyat karein. Shak ho to non-thrust mobilisation karein ya refer karein.

summary.en: The thoracic spine can be treated for neck pain: thrust or non-thrust mobilisation can give short-term relief, best combined with exercise and education.
summary.ur: Gardan ke dard mein thoracic spine ka ilaaj ho sakta hai: thrust ya non-thrust mobilisation short-term rahat de sakti hai, jo exercise aur education ke saath behtar hai.

summary.en: Choose non-thrust for irritable, anxious or unsafe-for-thrust patients, and thrust for less irritable, comfortable patients without a contraindication.
summary.ur: Irritable, pareshan ya thrust ke liye na-mehfooz patients ke liye non-thrust, aur kam irritable, mutmain patients ke liye jin mein contraindication na ho, thrust chunein.

summary.en: Screen and consent first, re-test after, teach an exercise and never thrust over fracture risk, tumour, infection or cord signs.
summary.ur: Pehle screen aur consent lein, baad mein dobara test karein, exercise sikhayen aur fracture risk, tumour, infection ya cord signs par kabhi thrust na karein.

front.en: Which part of the spine can be treated for neck pain?
front.ur: Gardan ke dard ke liye reerh ka kaunsa hissa treat ho sakta hai?

back.en: The upper thoracic spine, with thrust or non-thrust mobilisation.
back.ur: Upper thoracic spine, thrust ya non-thrust mobilisation se.

front.en: When is non-thrust the better choice?

back.en: For an irritable, very painful or anxious patient, or when a thrust is not safe.
back.ur: Irritable, bohat dardnak ya pareshan patient ke liye, ya jab thrust mehfooz na ho.

front.en: Name two reasons not to thrust.
front.ur: Thrust na karne ki do wajoohat batayein.

back.en: Fracture risk (osteoporosis, recent trauma) or a possible serious condition (tumour, infection, cord signs).
back.ur: Fracture ka khatra (osteoporosis, haal ki chot) ya mumkin serious bimari (tumour, infection, cord signs).

front.ur: Technique ke baad kya hona chahiye?

back.en: Re-testing of movement and pain, then an exercise to keep the change.
back.ur: Harkat aur dard ka dobara test, phir badlao barqarar rakhne ke liye exercise.

note.en: Screen the neck for artery problems before you treat.
note.ur: Ilaaj se pehle gardan ki artery ke masail ki screening karein.
